7.2 L-PDU Transmission
Due to the time-triggered schedule, the L-PDU transmission is scheduled according to
the Matrix Cycle configured during initialization, i.e. a call of the function Can_-
Write() does not directly trigger an immediate transmission but rather stores the L-
-PDU in the corresponding HW object, which is scheduled for transmission in a specific
Time Window.
[SWS_TtCan_00156] ⌈It shall be possible to map all transmit message objects to
specific Time Windows (see TTCAN ISO Specification [1]) by configuration (see
TTCANIF145_Conf, TTCANIF146_Conf, TTCANIF147_Conf, TTCANIF148_Conf).⌋
(SRS_TtCan_41003)
